description: The COBOL-2014 INITIALIZE category-name FUNCTION-POINTER (ISO 14.9.20.2) - the one of the printed thirteen that entered with the 2014 USAGE FUNCTION-POINTER category, and that ISO 8.9 reserves from 2014. Same parse-arm gate as initialize-category-2002. kb/Work PB415.
vcr: 2014 introduction (the USAGE FUNCTION-POINTER category; usage-function-pointer-2014 is its twin)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
FUNCTION-ID. RWIF14D.
DATA DIVISION.
LINKAGE SECTION.
01 L-ARG PIC 9(9).
01 L-RES PIC 9(9).
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING L-ARG RETURNING L-RES.
F-MAIN.
    COMPUTE L-RES = L-ARG * 2
    GOBACK.
END FUNCTION RWIF14D.
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. RWICAT14.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
REPOSITORY.
    FUNCTION RWIF14D.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 FP USAGE FUNCTION-POINTER TO RWIF14D.
01 FQ USAGE FUNCTION-POINTER TO RWIF14D.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    INITIALIZE FP REPLACING FUNCTION-POINTER DATA BY FQ.
    STOP RUN.
END PROGRAM RWICAT14.
